features: REDMI 17 5G – mAhximum Power, mAhximum Style – The all-new addition to the REDMI Number Series, built for those who want standout design paired with serious performance and battery life.
ALL-NEW RGB RING LIGHT DESIGN – A bold new camera module with a glowing ring accent, a first for the entire REDMI Number Series, making a striking style statement
7900mAh MASSIVE BATTERY – Segment-leading battery capacity for extended usage, so you can go longer between charges without compromising on performance
SNAPDRAGON 4 GEN 5 PROCESSOR – Built on an efficient 4nm process, the newest Snapdragon platform in its class delivers smooth multitasking, gaming, and everyday performance
45W FAST CHARGING WITH CHARGER IN-BOX – Power up quickly and get back to what matters, with the charger included right in the box, no extra purchase needed
LARGE 17.53cm (6.9) SMOOTH 120Hz ADAPTIVE DISPLAY – Enjoy an immersive viewing experience with a smooth adaptive refresh rate, perfect for scrolling, streaming, and gaming
TRIPLE TUV RHEINLAND CERTIFIED DISPLAY – Low Blue Light, Flicker-Free, and Circadian Friendly certifications keep your eyes comfortable even during long usage sessions.
50MP AI DUAL CAMERA – Capture sharp, vibrant photos tuned for Indian lighting conditions, complete with a flicker sensor for stable, true-to-life shots.
DUAL STEREO SPEAKERS WITH XIAOMI SOUND – Immersive audio tuned for movies, music, and calls, so entertainment sounds as good as it looks.
4 YEARS OF OS UPDATES + 6 YEARS OF SECURITY UPDATES – Long-term software support keeps your phone modern, secure, and reliable for years after purchase.
